# site commands

Every `site` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `site:head`

Show or set the site's head values (analytics id, verification tokens)

```bash
bin/semitexa site:head
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--set` | yes |
| `--unset` | yes |
| `--json` | no |
